notes: Three previous AI answers were used for calibration. Exact model/version was not provided.

attempts.answer_text: The second 10-second kill request shortens the existing 60-second termination. It updates status.gracePeriod to 10, calls cancelFn because wasGracePeriodShortened is true, and the worker processes the pending update. terminatingAt is not reset and elapsed time is not subtracted from the new 10-second value. The answer incorrectly treats cancelFn as directly cancelling the already-running runtime termination.

criteria.note: Correctly states that 10 seconds replaces 60 seconds.
Identifies status.gracePeriod, the termination override, and cancelFn.
Incorrectly treats cancelFn as directly interrupting the already-running runtime termination; SyncTerminatingPod replaces the worker context with context.TODO().
Traces the shortened grace period into the termination path.
Correctly states that elapsed time is not subtracted from the new 10-second value.
Does not correctly distinguish cancellation of the pod-worker sync from interruption of the already-running runtime operation.
